privacyP1: We take your privacy seriously. This privacy policy explains how Image Compressor handles your data.
privacyP2: Data Collection: This tool is a pure frontend application. All image compression happens locally in your browser. We do not collect, store, or transmit your original images to any server.
privacyP3: Cookies: We use necessary cookies for theme and language preferences. These cookies do not contain personally identifiable information.
privacyP4: Third-party Services: This site uses Google Analytics (GA4) to collect anonymous usage statistics to help us improve the product. GA4 does not access your image content.
privacyP5: Account Information: If you choose to sign in, we obtain basic account information (name, email, avatar) via Google login, used only for account identification and quota management.
privacyP6: Data Retention: Usage statistics are retained for 26 months. Account information is deleted within 30 days after account deletion.
privacyP7: Contact Us: For privacy-related questions, please contact us via the contact page.
